scope: Development only; Speed unseen interpolation; original single-query scores and multiaction rollout diagnostics remain different protocols

protocol.response: Centered conditional prediction error / centered target energy; equals paired response NRE for balanced binary conditions on the same panel. Not the original task score.
protocol.weighting: Equal conditions, candidate actions and horizons within scene; ratio of summed energies within checkpoint; then equal mean across training repetitions.
protocol.reference: Task-specific native latent condition mean. Zero conditional response has response ratio 1; perfect conditional response 0. Complete error includes common bias.
protocol.history_gain: (wrong-history error - matched-history error) / same all-horizon target energy; uniform other histories, from existing history validation.
protocol.uncertainty: 1000 source-group paired bootstrap draws, seed 20261009; checkpoints fixed. Training SD separate; no cross-encoder physical ranking.
protocol.real_input: Privileged real-observation diagnostic corrects state AND refreshes evidence; not a uniquely identified causal effect.
protocol.delay: 11 delays weighted equally in this multi-action diagnostic; differs from original six physical-group macro score.
protocol.zero_separation: No scenes/horizons filtered. Aggregate denominators must be positive; zero aggregate is undefined.
